density_selection: For f(y)=y^2[(y-1)^2+epsilon], the local energy-per-norm extremum is y_+=(2+sqrt(1-3epsilon))/3. At y_+, f=y f_prime and the spatial-zero-mode energy equals standing frequency times canonical norm.
scope: A smooth positive polynomial of same-field C+K and C-K currents. Constant-density square-unitary zero-mode and shell weights remain inverse premises; no physical spatial support, global energy minimum, cross-depth embedding or complete stability.
